transport: sdb/26101; one read operation per request; remote RC and DONE/FAIL
identity_stop: Stop immediately on rpi4 kernel or unified-toolchain/development image; unknown product-image identity also stops. Never identify by IP.
candidate_mapping: Existing private desensitize_map.tsv; exact comm match; disclose nearby names separately, do not silently substitute.
supplemental_candidates: Top 10 accessible userspace processes ranked by the historical glibc-heap-PD heuristic; require whole-system PID view and disclose races/coverage.

sampling.targets: Union of all live named candidates and top-10 supplementary PIDs; no target stimulation
sampling.clock: Host monotonic deadlines; record each read's UTC interval and lateness; do not fabricate simultaneous acquisition or replace missing samples.
sampling.smaps_definition: Identical to product_cyclic_target_probe_20260814/collect_timeseries.sh: [heap] OR unnamed rw-p, start aligned 1 MiB, 0 < size <= 1 MiB; other writable anonymous mappings separately; remainder file-backed bucket.
sampling.quality: Remote proof required; classified PD sums to total; stable PID/start_ticks and monotonic faults. Stop on missing required fields, unreadable candidate or process restart. Optional absent zram is recorded as absent, never zero.

analysis.classifier: Reuse cyclic_fall_attribution_20260901/audit_phenotypes.py release_ratio_census without changing thresholds, including dual a+b labels. First current sample is baseline, not a historical sample.
analysis.attribution_audit: Report all positive zram steps, major faults and total-PD/other-anon changes around the largest heap drawdown. A classifier label alone is not unique proof of a glibc mechanism.
analysis.floor: Absolute minimum heap PD; first-minute minimum and last-minute minimum; difference of those two minima as within-window floor change. Never equate current absolute PD to historical activity-induced increments or allocator free bytes.
analysis.comparison_limit: Passive ten-minute observation is not the historical remote-key activity protocol; live/bin decomposition and recoverability remain unmeasured.

failure: Any identity/transport/required observation gate failure stops this stage; publish completed host work, partial evidence and stop reason; no retries that rerun completed observations.
publication: Full raw evidence host-only board_results; compact alias-only evidence data/raw; report reproduction section; endpoint/privacy scan zero before push. No demo branch change.
